description: This file contains functions and methods related to processing post metadata, link previews, embedded content, and associated caching in the Mattermost server. It handles link metadata retrieval, sanitization, and post preparation for client display.

methods.name: initPostMetadata
methods.description: Initializes post metadata handling, including cache invalidation on proxy setting changes.

methods.name: PreparePostListForClient
methods.description: Prepares a list of posts for client display, including embedding, translation, and priority data.

methods.name: populatePostListTranslations
methods.description: Fetches and populates translation metadata for posts lacking it, based on user language.

methods.name: OverrideIconURLIfEmoji
methods.description: Overrides post icon URL if an emoji override is specified.

methods.name: PreparePostForClient
methods.description: Prepares a single post for client display, including metadata, reactions, files, and embeds.

methods.name: preparePostFilesForClient
methods.description: Fetches and attaches file metadata to a post for client display.

methods.name: PreparePostForClientWithEmbedsAndImages
methods.description: Prepares a post with embedded content and images for client display.

methods.name: getEmbedsAndImages
methods.description: Retrieves embedded content and images for a post based on its message and metadata.

methods.name: removePermalinkMetadataFromPost
methods.description: Removes permalink embed metadata from a post.

methods.name: removeEmbeddedPostsFromMetadata
methods.description: Removes permalink embeds from post metadata, keeping only non-permalink embeds.

methods.name: SanitizePostMetadataForUser
methods.description: Sanitizes post metadata based on user permissions, removing inaccessible permalink embeds.

methods.name: sanitizeChannelMentionsForUser
methods.description: Filters channel mentions in post props based on user permissions to prevent info leaks.

methods.name: SanitizePostListMetadataForUser
methods.description: Sanitizes a list of posts' metadata for a user, respecting permissions.

methods.name: getFileMetadataForPost
methods.description: Retrieves file info for a post.

methods.name: getEmojisAndReactionsForPost
methods.description: Fetches emojis and reactions for a post.

methods.name: getEmbedForPost
methods.description: Generates embed content for a post based on its message and link previews.

methods.name: getImagesForPost
methods.description: Extracts images from post embeds and metadata.

methods.name: looksLikeAPermalink
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the permalink pattern.

methods.name: containsPermalink
methods.description: Determines if a post message contains a permalink.

methods.name: filterSVGImage
methods.description: Filters out SVG images from post images.

methods.name: getLinkMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves link metadata, utilizing cache and database, for link previews.

methods.name: getLinkMetadataForPermalink
methods.description: Fetches permalink metadata for embedded posts.

methods.name: getLinkMetadataFromOEmbed
methods.description: Fetches link metadata via oEmbed provider.

methods.name: getLinkMetadataForURL
methods.description: Fetches link metadata for a URL, including images and OpenGraph data.

methods.name: parseLinkMetadata
methods.description: Parses link content to extract OpenGraph or image metadata.

methods.name: parseImages
methods.description: Extracts image info from image URLs and content.
